Name: valley girl-caroline(Childhood Sweetheart Caroline)Compatibility
Author: CokeCharger
Description:
[left][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/left]
This is a compatibility patch for Childhood Sweetheart Caroline (Overhaul) and Valley Girl.
It fixes the portrait conflict where the Valley Girl portraits were being overwritten by Childhood Sweetheart Caroline (Overhaul). It also replaces the Caroline-pleasure portraits using cropped and rearranged assets from Childhood Sweetheart Caroline (Overhaul).
I am a sophomore student and made this patch because no compatibility version was available on Nexus Mods. If there are any copyright concerns, please get in touch and I will remove this file immediately.


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Simply overwrite your original Valley Girl mod files with the files from this patch.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
- Resolves portrait conflict between the two mods 
- Restores and replaces Caroline-pleasure portraits using assets from Childhood Sweetheart Caroline (Overhaul) 
- Does NOT modify any Caroline sprites — they remain unchanged from the original Valley Girl mod
